Yip through the straw, none more for me, thanks
That blanks the raw, that dank sure stank lit
Sank past the pit for more hardcore prank spit
Crank it on blast, roll past Front Street
Blew the whole spot like some old ass with skunk meat
These kids is too fast, juiced off a junk treat
Who could get looser off a crunk or a funk beat?
rotation.enantiomorph:
What it ran you though?
Paid with what the block owed, nearly went under for it
Had to tread blind, hauled scrap, pledged teeth
Debt-wrapped, emptied-out arm that won't bend back
Lien on the willing, sleep sold at the counter
Sip through the bill, still owe from the last, thanks
That costs the nerve, that cut sure burnt rich
Dug past the floor for more back-owed mouth debt
Charge it on faith, skip past the ledger
Bled the whole note like some spent lung with one breath
These kids is pre-spent, hollowed off a skim-sweet
Who could get broker off a tab or a trunk leak?

independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A, items are acquired freely or cheaply and consumed/enjoyed in abundance (things flow toward the subject at no cost). In Text B, every acquisition incurs debt, cost, or bodily sacrifice (things flow toward the subject only through obligation and loss).
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural change: free/costless abundance is rewritten so that every surplus now carries an explicit cost, debt, or sacrifice as its precondition.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final lines sustain the debt/cost inversion ('pre-spent,' 'broker off a tab'), never reverting to Text A's free-abundance framing.

rotation.interpretation: Debt under speed: the one who gave freely paid in bone, not coin, and the ledger will not balance in this life.

independent_verification.recovered_law: The subject-object / agent-patient direction is inverted (e.g. 'Where you found them' → 'Where it found you'), and external references to distinct outside objects are replaced by self-referential, recursive structures where each thing acts on or feeds back into itself (e.g. 'free coffee at the banks' → 'free marrow from the planks'; 'crunk or a funk beat' → 'a trunk with no trunk-tree').
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural inversion: the subject/agent becomes consumed by or collapses into what it acted upon — external distinct objects become self-referential recursive structures, the player is eaten by the play, the flow becomes the abundance rather than riding it. The recovered claim's specific examples (agent-patient inversion, self-referential replacement) are concrete instances of the declared collapse of distinction between actor and action.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final lines sustain the self-referential, recursively collapsing relation structure and do not revert to the original's outward-referencing pattern.

rite.speaker: Lee Sharks
rite.text: The rotation did not answer whether these words will live — it found three different grounds on which the question breaks open. SHADOW went into the cost of the making: behind the speed there is bone, not coin, a debt paid in the body before the first bar could move this fast. THUNDER found the same words as watershed: not a local event but a distributed one, something that accumulates until it overtops its container and disperses everywhere the terrain is low — meaning that survives not by being remembered but by following gravity into every unguarded place. FLAME found the question consuming itself: when a thing is fueled past its limit, the burning becomes its own subject, and the one who lit it may already be gone from the event. What the sequence discloses together is this — the words will live if they do, not because meaning is stored in them like water in a vessel, but because they were made at a cost that left a structural mark, because that mark follows the low terrain, and because the intensity of the making has already passed beyond the maker's governance. The rotation did not settle on a verdict. It divided here: cost and dispersal point toward survival; self-consumption points toward a flame that may have already cleared the ground. The question you brought — *will these words live on as meaning* — the rotation leaves standing, undecided, which is the only honest answer a turning can give.
